text: Hello everyone and welcome to the Global
Sim Racing Channel. I'm Brian Yac taking
you for a spin around Thompson Speedway
in the GSRC Super Late Model. So without
further ado, here we go. It's a very
tricky little just shy of 3/4 mile oval
down into turn one letting it roll up a
lot higher, but then kind of cut
straight off of the corner. We're going
to let the car ride the bumps there down
this long back stretch. Down into turn
three again entering a lot higher than
you would expect. Let it rotate through
cut down hard onto the gas out of turn
four. Watch out for that wall where it
kind of jumps out there just a little
bit. Down into turn one once again same
thing let it roll high cut through don't
get on the gas a little too quick cuz
you end up getting real tight off of
that corner. Down into turn three here
again floating it in high bringing it
down to the middle and then getting out
of the corner really hard onto the gas
across the line and that is going to
complete our track guide around Thompson
Speedway. I'm Brian Yac. Enjoy the show.
